As a member of the Hellion Court, Lady Basjas (pronounced ba-ZHA; rhymes with Rajah) is the most powerful Nightmare from Monde, one of the Gaunt Man's drained worlds in which France had become the largest colonial power instead of England. She was born 200 years ago as Sabathina DeLaunay. Her father imprisoned her mother in the attic on false pretenses, leading her mother to kill herself. When Sabathina became a rebellious teen, her father had her committed in an asylum run by the demented Dr. Melgrath. There, she learned how to control spiders and used that ability to escape. By that point her world had been invaded by the Gaunt Man and his horrors. Sabathina got married, but when her husband was slain by a vampire, she summoned spiders to slay the fiend, thereby becoming a vampire herself. Sabathina took the name "Basjas" and went on to become a powerful Nightmare, traveling with the Gaunt Man on his rapacious invasions across many cosms as a member of his elite Hellion Court.As a vampire, Basjas has most of the classical weaknesses of her kind: allergy to sunlight, aversion to garlic, and loathing of holy symbols. But her vampiric affinity is to spiders, rather than bats. Her "purest" form is that of a huge spider, but her vanity causes her to strongly favor her human appearance. Just as vampires may turn into mist, Basjas may turn into a swarm of spiders. In this form she is much weaker—use the Poison Spider Swarm profile, but retain her . She scatters to reform later if Defeated. Most of the time, Basjas appears as a beautiful woman in her 30s. She has dark curly hair, fair skin, a heart-shaped face, and captivating eyes. She prefers high fashion of the style common in Orrorsh—fancy dresses, large hats, and parasols—with spider- or web-like embellishments. Around her neck is a fine chain bearing a ruby, a wedding gift from her long-dead husband. Basjas' mission for the Gaunt man is to do nothing more than she would do naturally: inspire just enough hope with her beautiful performances to bring the horrors of Orrorsh into focus, and then subvert that hope by using her "other talents" to spread all-consuming fear, corruption, and death. Her personal goals are less clear-cut. She barely remembers the details of her past, but she suspects there was never anything wrong with her mother aside from being strong-willed in an age where that was not acceptable for women. She's positive all her mother's other mental maladies were to do with the horrific treatment by Basjas' father. As a major Nightmare, Basjas is a very powerful and complex being who transcends the normal bounds of reality. She was not born this way. She was made through a series of horrific events, the loss of key memories and people who grounded her, and the festering corruption brought on by the Gaunt Man and his conquest of her world. She has several secrets, all of which need to be discovered and communicated to Basjas herself to bring about her True Death. Origin: Uncover Basjas' original identity, Sabathina DeLaunay, and speak her name to her. Habit: Discover Basjas feeds from male audience members who attend one of her shows at the Oubliette Theater and behave in a way that shows disrespect toward her performance. Desire: Discover Basjas yearns above all to be adored, a desire which is linked to her love of acting, her lost years without human contact during her institutionalization, the loss of her mother, and her emotionally detached father. Link: Locate the lullaby once sung to Basjas by her mother and sing it to her. Token: Find Basjas' father still alive—preserved in an undead state through centuries of torture by his daughter—and slay him. True Death: The only way to permanently kill Basjas is to bind her in the way she binds her prey, then destroy her body with the cleansing nature of fire. She must be enshrouded in twine or rope that has been blessed, then her body must be burned to ash. Unlike other vampires, a stake through the heart or exposure to sunlight only temporarily destroys her body, and she is formed once more a few days later.

Basjas can change at will to one of her several different forms. The process takes a full round to complete, during which she can take no actions other than to defend. The exception is her spider swarm form which she can assume instantly on her action.

","Enthrall":"

Basjas may enthrall a single foe who can see her with a contest of willpower or Mind. She has a -4 penalty if the target is in a hostile state. If she fails, she cannot enthrall that target for the rest of the scene. She may direct his actions until the end of the target's next turn on a Standard Success, for one minute on a Good success, or until the end of the current scene on an Outstanding Success. Commands which drastically oppose the target's nature, such as harming himself or an ally, force another contest of willpower or Mind.

","Dread":"
